name: gdp-per-capita-long-run
title: GDP per Capita over the Long Run (Maddison Project 2023 and Penn World Table 11.0)
description: Real GDP per person and population by country and year, for comparing living standards across countries and over long periods. The main series is the Maddison Project Database 2023 (Bolt and van Zanden): 169 countries, in 2011 international dollars, with estimates for year 1 for 14 countries, 1820 for 55, 1950 for 146 and 2022 for all 169, plus Maddison's regional and world aggregates. A second file gives Penn World Table 11.0 (Feenstra, Inklaar and Timmer) real GDP per person at chained PPPs in 2021 US dollars, 185 countries, 1950-2023. The two sources differ by design and should not be mixed in one series. Frozen snapshot of the 2023 and 11.0 releases.

resources.name: maddison-gdp-per-capita
resources.title: Maddison Project 2023: GDP per capita and population by country and year

fields.name: country_code
fields.description: Three-letter country code as used by the Maddison Project: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3, plus former states CSK (Czechoslovakia), SUN (Former USSR) and YUG (Former Yugoslavia). SDN is Sudan before the 2011 split and TZA is mainland Tanzania.

fields.name: country
fields.description: Country name as given by the Maddison Project.

fields.name: year
fields.description: Calendar year. Before 1820 only scattered benchmark years exist; most countries are annual from 1950.

fields.name: gdp_per_capita
fields.description: Real GDP per capita in 2011 international dollars (2011 PPPs), rounded to cents. Empty where the Maddison Project gives population but no GDP estimate.

fields.name: population
fields.description: Mid-year population, persons (the source gives thousands, here multiplied by 1,000 and rounded). Empty where there is no estimate.

fields.name: region
fields.description: Maddison Project region the country belongs to.

resources.name: maddison-regions
resources.title: Maddison Project 2023: regional and world GDP per capita and population

fields.name: year
fields.description: Calendar year: every 10 years 1820-2010, then annual 2015-2022.

fields.name: gdp_per_capita
fields.description: Real GDP per capita in 2011 international dollars, as computed by the Maddison Project from the country estimates available. Empty where not given.

fields.name: population
fields.description: Population, persons (source thousands times 1,000, rounded). Given only for some years before 1950.

resources.name: pwt-gdp-per-capita
resources.title: Penn World Table 11.0: real GDP per capita at chained PPPs, 1950-2023

fields.name: country_code
fields.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code, as in PWT.

fields.name: country
fields.description: Country name as given in PWT.

fields.name: rgdpe_per_capita
fields.description: Expenditure-side real GDP at chained PPPs per person, 2021 US dollars (PWT rgdpe divided by pop). PWT recommends this for comparing living standards across countries and over time.

fields.name: rgdpo_per_capita
fields.description: Output-side real GDP at chained PPPs per person, 2021 US dollars (PWT rgdpo divided by pop). Measures productive capacity; differs from rgdpe mainly through terms of trade.

fields.name: population
fields.description: Population, persons (PWT pop in millions times 1,000,000, rounded).
